description.text: sits low inside a sealed, featureless space. Only thin, sliding highlights reveal the long bodywork and the cool sheen of its carbon fibre panels, while the rest of the shape stays submerged in shadow. The ground around it is smooth and empty, with no horizon or detail to catch the eye. The sealed space offers no other objects or landmarks, only a smooth floor and a blanket of darkness that makes the car's reflective surfaces feel isolated. At first the car is little more than a set of reflective edges: a glint along the roofline, a faint streak down one flank, a soft gleam on the nose. Then the headlights snap on and throw a hard cone of pale light forward, cutting across the ground and catching dust in the air. The sudden wash outlines the nose and the leading edges of the body, and the engine catches with a low, uneven idle that fills the space. Reflections sharpen across the carbon fibre, and the car settles into a tense, idling stillness. The light stays fixed ahead, and after a beat the first gentle forward movement begins, breaking the sealed darkness.
